images.title: Build 302 tile by tile
images.purpose: Shows the core move of the Roman numeral builder: placing landmark tiles until the running total matches the target 302.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. A target box at the top, a build row of five tiles in the middle with small values under them, and a running total box at the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Top centre: a rounded box with reddish purple (#CC79A7) outline containing target 302. Middle: a row of exactly 5 square tiles (white fill, dark outline): C, C, C, I, I. Under each C, in small teal (#0072B2) text, 100; under each I, 1. Bottom centre: a rounded box with teal outline containing total 302 and a small green (#009E73) tick beside it. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Place the largest landmarks first until the total matches: 302 is CCCII.
images.description: Shows the core move of the Roman numeral builder: placing landmark tiles until the running total matches the target 302.

image_decisions.why: The doer image shows the builder's one action: adding tiles until the total meets the target.
